add: end game system!!

finally, there's a way to win the game. or draw, if you dare.
added a method to evaluate if the opposite team has any legal moves at the end of a turn. If it doesn't, it can be either a stalemate or a checkmate, it depends only on if the king is in check.
now that the game can reach an end, the new_turn method also has to return if the game is over or not.

add: Piece.set_first_move

the first_move attribute would be set to True each time the method to get the possible piece's moves was invoked. But since checking requires the code to see all possible moves for all pieces, it ended up setting to false at the end of the first turn.
to  avoid this, I created a set function to set it to false manually after the end of a turn.

add: rudimentary check system

- prevents a piece from being selected if it doesn't stop an ongoing check or if it is pinned

add: test_moves

the loss condition was wrong: with the merging mechanic, it can actually be possible to have no empty tiles left while still being able to make a move, we just need to determine which moves are possible based on the current grid state. The test_moves method will clone the current grid and move it to any direction, comparing both grids afterwards. If it changes, the game goes on and the key can be pressed. If not, it's game over.
